DIAGNOSIS READY: Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis (ALS).

The combination of progressive upper limb weakness, muscle fasciculations, absent reflexes, and paresthesias in a patient with diabetes strongly suggests motor neuron disease. The sensory symptoms may be due to co-morbid diabetic neuropathy, but the motor findings are distinct.
